regime.label: Dealer short-gamma squeeze field, spot 1026.2 grinding toward the live 1000 put wall
evidence: -6,445 total net GEX (gamma x OI x 200) with no zero-crossing anywhere in the 960-1150 chain: dealers are structurally short gamma, so hedging chases the move instead of fading it. 1040 is only a per-strike sign change, not an aggregate flip.
-3,118 net GEX inside +/-20 points of the 1030 ATM, and spot 1026.2 sits below that 1040 sign change, in the most negative pocket of the chain (-2,855 at 1000, -2,243 at 1020).
+2,011 put OI added in 5 sessions (11,626 to 13,637) concentrated at 1000 (+581) and 1020 (+555) while spot fell 41.0 points: insurance demand is the fuel, not an unwind.

434 contracts traded on the 1020 put today with +264 OI vs yesterday and spot 6.2 points away: Vol2Vol confirms it live. The 1100 call wall (2,262 OI, 112 vol, 73.8 points away) is structural, not active.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1026.2 on the Z future, -6.3 today and -41.0 points (-3.8%) off the 1067.2 high of 27 Oct. Net GEX printed -6,445, the second session of a dealer short-gamma field after the +614 to -3,127 flip on 31 Oct, which means hedging now amplifies rather than dampens. 1.22 put/call volume vs 1.00 on OI shows today's flow is put-side while standing positioning is still balanced. Max pain sits 23.8 points overhead at 1050 and has not moved in 8 sessions, so it is a stale anchor the tape is walking away from, not a magnet.
what_changed: Net GEX flipped sign: +2,987 on 27 Oct to -3,127 on 31 Oct to -6,445 today, the single highest-signal event in the set - dealers went from stabiliser to amplifier.
ATM IV expanded +1.46 points, 10.78 to 12.24, lifting the 1-sigma day from 7.25 to 7.91 points while price fell - vol bid into weakness, not crushed.
Put OI at 1000 built +581 and at 1020 +555 over 5 sessions, pulling the active near-money put wall up from 960 to 1000.
Call OI at 1100 added +592 to 2,262 even as spot fell 41 points, hardening overhead supply well above the 1050 near-call wall.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: The decisive change vs 27 Oct is the GEX sign: +2,987 then, -6,445 now, with the crossover on 31 Oct - the same session the future lost 15.2 points. Max pain has been frozen at 1050 for 8 straight sessions while spot drifted 41.0 points below it, which is the max-pain failure signature rather than a pin: price is moving away from the structure with 2,044 put contracts of confirming flow and IV expanding +1.46 points, so fading toward 1050 is the wrong read here. The put wall stayed at 960 all week but the live wall migrated up to 1000 (+581 OI), compressing the short-gamma air pocket between 1026.2 and 1000 to 26 points. Call OI building at 1100 (+592) against falling spot says the overhead is being sold into, not bought. With 56 DTE there is no expiry pin to lean on, so the structure reduces to one question: does 1000 hold, or do short-gamma dealers chase a break through it.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1020 / 990
strategies.rationale: Expresses the short-gamma Squeeze at the one strike Vol2Vol confirms live - 434 contracts and +264 OI on the 1020 put today with spot 6.2 points away - instead of the stale 1100 call wall.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 8.15 points net debit (mid 17.50 - 9.35); max gain 21.85 points on the 30-point width.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1040, where per-strike net GEX turns positive and dealer hedging starts dampening again.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1000 / 970 (break expression)
strategies.rationale: Pays only if the 1000 near-put wall (1,863 OI) gives way, which is exactly where a -2,855 net GEX pocket forces dealers to sell into the decline and accelerate it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 5.45 points net debit (mid 11.50 - 6.05); max gain 24.55 points on the 30-point width.
strategies.invalidation: 1000 holding on a retest with put volume drying up, or any reclaim of 1040.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1040 / 1070 (contingent mirror)
strategies.rationale: The defined-risk way to express the invalidation case: above 1040 net GEX per strike turns positive, and the 1050 near-call wall (1,613 OI) then caps the first 24 points of any recovery.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 8.40 points net debit (mid 14.35 - 5.95); max gain 21.60 points on the 30-point width.
strategies.invalidation: Failure to hold 1040 after reclaiming it, which puts spot back in the short-gamma pocket.

S50Z26.prediction: Bias lower while 1026.2 trades below the 1040 gamma sign change, with 1000 the first magnet - 26 points away, or 3.3 times the 7.91-point 1-sigma day - and a break there opening 970/960 because short-gamma hedging sells into it. 1-sigma to the 29 Dec expiry is 48.8 points, so the 960 put wall is inside a normal distribution, not a tail. A daily close above 1040 invalidates the bearish read and hands the tape back to long-gamma dampening into the 1050 near-call wall.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks: treat max pain 1050 and the 1000/1050 walls as tendencies, not guarantees. Defined-risk is not risk-free - the full net debit on each structure above is a real loss outcome. With 56 DTE and macro flow able to override the option structure outright, the 1050 anchor that has not moved in 8 sessions should be read as stale rather than predictive.
